snippet.title: Gold Gold Adventure Gold - 1.0 Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
GO FOR GOLD & PLAY NOW ON MAY 15th! ✅ 
https://t.co/FbGbmdCf3C

Hire Adventurers to take on Quests and hope for the best as our fantasy rogue-like city builder, Gold Gold Adventure Gold launching in 1.0 on May 15th!

In this world, it’s all about the gold! Use it to build up a fantasy town, recruit heroes, give quests, raise a Godbeast, cast powerful spells and expand your influence—all one gold coin at a time.
